notes.title: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo is also coming to Nintendo Switch and Xbox!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40552456/5581b4b5a6fb5c8c767b01eae15f43f005cb58f3.png[/img]

[h1]The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo is now available for pre-sale on Nintendo Switch and Xbox![/h1]

The captivating point and click adventure game, [i]"The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo"[/i], created by the talented cartoonist and animator Nacho Rodriguez, is now [b]available for pre-sale on [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/the-many-pieces-of-mr-coo-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url] and [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/the-many-pieces-of-mr-coo/9PCGG15VSS07]Xbox[/url][/b]

Still don't know this wonder called [i]"The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo"[/i]? 
Immerse yourself in an exciting game that combines [b]traditional animation and stop motion[/b], thanks to the skill of Nacho Rodriguez with the pencils. It is a true [b]vindication of art in videogames[/b], classic animation and the funniest comedy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40552456/cd0e44a666980f7f052981534b4d444bd9ed8f7d.gif[/img]

The plot is full of obnubilating happenings and eye-popping events that will leave you wide-eyed, all accompanied by a [b]hypnotic soundtrack[/b].

In [i]"The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo"[/i], you'll have the task of accompanying the charismatic Mr. Coo through a surreal, disturbing and colorful [b]world[/b] to solve the enigmas that surround him and help him rebuild his body. The character interacts in different ways, [b]adapting to the environment, objects and situations in surprising ways[/b].

You will soon be able to get your hands on this amazing game, if your wrists don't give out in excitement! Don't miss its [b]launch on September 7[/b].

Get ready to immerse yourself in a [b]unique experience[/b]!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602560/The_Many_Pieces_of_Mr_Coo/?l=english

notes.title: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo available on September 7, plus 2 physical editions!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40552456/5581b4b5a6fb5c8c767b01eae15f43f005cb58f3.png[/img]

[h1]The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo available on September 7, plus 2 exclusive physical editions ![/h1]

The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo is an[b] enigmatic Point&Click adventure[/b], with a surreal story, incredible [b]hand-drawn 2D animation[/b] and [b]hilarious puzzles[/b]. The game is developed by Nacho Rodriguez, supported by the PlayStation Talents Program and published by Meridiem Games, which you can already add to your wishlist and [b]will be available on September 7 for PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch and Steam[/b].

[previewyoutube=iEaV_e5A4pE;full][/previewyoutube]
The first physical edition is the [b]Fantabulous Edition[/b] of The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo. In it, in addition to the collector's item you've always wanted without knowing it, you can find an exclusive case, different for each platform, and a unique keychain of the character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40552456/3d3dc438c8c4eb19ac1e66bc8a5bbbe70b4ff0ca.png[/img]

And now we also know that there will be another physical edition of the video game, also distributed by Meridiem. As we were saying, it will be called Coollector Edition and will be loaded with more irresistible items than delusions you will find in the game's plot: a [b]different exclusive case for each platform[/b], the [b]exclusive Mr. Coo character keychain[/b], a [b]flipbook with two exclusive animated stories[/b], a [b]mysterious watercolor by artist Nacho Rodriguez[/b], a [b]Mr. Coo puzzle[/b] cut up like a calf, the [b]artist's making off book[/b] and a [b]7" vinyl with the game's music[/b] created by Julie Reier. All this packaged in a collector's box that will delight collectors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40552456/2c94a5a0ad7f091411e928dd0447b9dabfdb502f.png[/img]

As for the game, we've already told you what it's about, but we'll do it again because we love it. The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo is a [b]point-and-click adventure game[/b] that revives the [b]classic cartoon through stop-motion animation and hand-drawing[/b]. It is a truly author's game (Nacho Rodríguez, to be precise), with exciting adventures, crazy puzzles, hilarious scenes and chickens the size of skyscrapers

Add it now to your Wishlist on [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/10001016]PlayStation Store[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602560/The_Many_Pieces_of_Mr_Coo/?l=english]Steam[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602560/The_Many_Pieces_of_Mr_Coo/?l=english

notes.title: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo will be at Steam Next Fest 2022.
notes.content:
[b]Next June 13[/b], whoever is closely following the publications of the Steam Next Fest, will be surprised to discover [b]The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo[/b]. The point and click adventure game, created by cartoonist and animator [b]Nacho Rodríguez[/b] and developed by [b]Gammera Nest.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602560/The_Many_Pieces_of_Mr_Coo/

The Many Pieces Of Mr. Coo takes the player into a surreal world, where everything you imagine can happen, but usually happens the things you don't expect. Following Mr. Coo, the player will experience a frenetic battle between two antagonists who represent the endless struggle between absolute control and fun chaos.

[b]Featured content:[/b]
[list]
[*] A truly amazing 2D art direction.
[*] A narrative universe in which everything can happen.
[*] Clever puzzles to solve using its point and click mechanics.
[*] Lots of fun to laugh out loud.
[/list]
